cat > programs/task-a3bb2feb.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The center divider has a uniform color; the two equal-sized fields encode
    # sparse marks, whose overlaps are reported as 3 on an 8 background.
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and c > 0 and c < w - 1)
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider+1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    lmark = max(set(x for row in left for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in left for v in row))
    rmark = max(set(x for row in right for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in right for v in row))
    # Marks are the non-background colors in their respective panel.
    lmark = next(x for x in set(v for row in left for v in row) if x != lmark)
    rmark = next(x for x in set(v for row in right for v in row) if x != rmark)
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == lmark and right[r][c] == rmark else 8 for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
PY
